rubric.why: Identifies the ring-shaped arrangement of the devices.
rubric.description: States that the devices form a ring or circular arrangement.
rubric.how: Check for a ring or circular arrangement.

rubric.why: Describes how each device is connected to its neighbours.
rubric.description: States that each device connects to two neighbouring devices.
rubric.how: Check for a two-neighbour connection or equivalent wording.

modelAnswer: In a ring topology, each computer or device is connected to two neighbouring devices.
The connections form a closed circular path or ring.

items.followUp: What is the purpose of an IP address on a network?

rubric.why: Identifies an IP address as a logical or unique address.
rubric.description: States that an IP address is a logical or unique address assigned to a device.
rubric.how: Check for a logical or unique address.

rubric.why: Explains how an IP address helps identify a device or enables communication.
rubric.description: States that an IP address identifies a device or enables network communication.
rubric.how: Check for device identification or communication between devices.

modelAnswer: IP addressing assigns a logical address to a device on a network.
The IP address identifies the device and enables it to communicate with other devices.
